thread:
incident-bot: P1: KV-cache memory spike -> OOMs on hosted-runtime (us-west-2). Alerts: 6 nodes degraded, ~12% request errors. Auto-mitigation triggered but failures > threshold. Paging on-call. https://pager.example/INC-2105 :alert:

alex_chung: Ack. Oncall here. Starting triage — assigning tasks. Who's owning runtime hotpatch?

maria_sre: I saw the spike — continuous-batching + prefetch controller hit a pathological case with very long prompts (~180k tokens in some requests). KV entries exploded due to prefix amplification. GC/eviction couldn't keep up and we hit device OOM on some shards.

alex_chung: Can you paste the relevant metric graphs/log snippets?

maria_sre: Posted monitoring snippet:

```
kvcache.total_entries{service="hosted-runtime",region="us-west-2"} 1.8e7
kvcache.memory_used_mb{shard=3} 31240
runtime.oom.count 7
batcher.pending_tokens 450k
prefetch.inflight_requests 120
```

maria_sre: Big clue: prefetch.window_size was recently nudged up in config rollout 210501 to improve cold-start perf. That change allowed larger prefetch windows and enabled a growth loop for long-context jobs.

ryan_runtime: I'm rolling back prefetch.window_size to 512 -> deploy-hotpatch-2105a. Will also flip prefetch.enabled=false as a short-circuit if rollback fails.

deploy-bot: deploy start: rollout/hotfix/prefetch-rollback @ryan_runtime (job 9876). Canary 2/10 -> 200ms latency spike observed -> continuing.

ben_ops: Noted. I'll throttle new batch creation at the router layer to reduce batch size and set kvcache.eviction_rate to aggressive for us-west-2 to free memory. Commands I'm running on prod-controller:

```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/reconfigure -d '{"batch.max_tokens":256, "batch.max_requests":8, "kvcache.eviction_mode":"aggressive"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

sam_engineer: Also saw a few customer traces where a single request included a pasted log file (~150MB) that expanded to ~100k tokens after tokenization — we're going to add a size-guard at ingress to reject > 50k tokens with 413 and a clear error for now.

emma_prod: Customer impact: Affected customers: Playbird (live chat), DataFjord (background embeddings), demo cluster for internal QA. Playbird reported ~40% of requests failing for ~6 minutes. We should prepare comms.

julie_support: Drafting incident blurb to affected customers now — will push with the status: mitigation in progress, recommendations: reduce long single-request uploads, temporary throttles applied.

maria_sre: Runtime logs with OOM stack sample:

```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] shard=3 ERROR AllocFailure: cudaMalloc failed when allocating 512MB for kv_bucket
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] backend: dropping request id=5f7c... reason=oom
[2026-03-15T14:12:04Z] kv_prefetch: requested window 65536 but actual capacity 4096
```

alex_chung: Good. What did the deploy do?

deploy-bot: rollout/hotfix/prefetch-rollback completed. 10/10 nodes -> success.

ryan_runtime: After rollback, kvcache entries started declining. evictions picked up. We'll keep prefetch disabled for 30m and monitor.

ben_ops: Router throttle applied, batch caps set. Latency normalized to baseline after ~90s. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.3%.

emma_prod: Playbird support says errors stopped after ~3 minutes from hotpatch. Sending proactive message now.

julie_support: Sent initial customer notif to Playbird & DataFjord with root-cause & temporary mitigations. I'll update status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2105123456

sam_engineer: I'm preparing an immediate follow-up PR adding an ingress token-count guard and a soft-limit that returns a helpful error with guidance. Also adding telemetry to flag token runaway patterns.

maria_sre: Action items (short-term):
- Keep prefetch disabled in us-west-2 for 30m
- Aggressive eviction on kvcache for region
- Router batch caps enforced
- Add 413 size guard at ingress (hotpatch to lambda/edge)

maria_sre: Action items (longer-term):
- Revisit prefetch.window sizing and add safety caps per model shard
- Improve kvcache accounting to account for post-tokenization expansion
- Add anomaly detection rule for token explosion patterns to auto-throttle
- Improve documentation for customers about max single-request size

alex_chung: Handing over to ben_ops for post-mitigation monitoring and next steps. Ben, can you take incident ownership for the follow-up and update Pager?

ben_ops: Taking over. I'll keep watch for 2 hours, escalate if any regression. Creating a follow-up ticket INC-2105-FU with checklist.

julie_support: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and postmortem comms draft.

ryan_runtime: Leaving a note: config rollout 210501 should be marked reverted and gated. I'll add a safety flag to require QA signoff for any prefetch increases.

maria_sre: Postmortem owners: maria_sre (root cause + remediation), sam_engineer (fix ingress + telemetry), ryan_runtime (config gating + runtime improvements), julie_support (customer comms).

alex_chung: Thanks everyone. Closing pager for now — monitoring status page. If anything flares, ping this thread with @here. :thumbsup:

ben_ops: Update @1h: metrics stable, no further OOMs, reducing eviction aggressiveness to normal. Will hand off to on-call rotation at 16:40 UTC.

alex_chung: Handoff acknowledged. End of thread.
